rationale: Karpurapu brings hands-on ML and computer vision expertise from award-winning work in Stanford's LLMxLAW program, while Mingze is building ML infrastructure and LLM tooling as CTO of Secludy—creating a natural fit where Karpurapu's research background and full-stack skills (Python, JavaScript, cloud computing) could directly support Mingze's infrastructure needs. intro_message: Karpurapu himavanth, meet Mingze He—your ML research and computer vision expertise could be valuable for his LLM infrastructure work at Secludy, and his systems-level perspective on model deployment might inform your next research direction.
